simple.meaning: טָלָא (ṭâlâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: טָלָא (H2921) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 30:32, with occurrences in Genesis, Joshua, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָלָא (H2921) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in טָלָא (H2921) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: טָלָא (ṭâlâʼ) / H2921 is traced through Genesis 30:32, Genesis 30:33, Genesis 30:35, Genesis 30:39 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry)
definitions.full: H2921. tala [ טָלָא ] verb patch, spot (Late Hebrew id., patch ) — Qal Passive participle טָלוּא Gen 30:32 (twice in verse); 30:33 ; plural טְלֻאִים 30:35 ; 30:39 ; טְלֻאוֺת Ezek 16:16 ; טְלֻאֹת ) Gen 30:35 ; chiefly of spotted, variegated sheep and goats (Jacob & Laban); || נְקֻדִּים נָקֹד, 30:32 (twice in verse); 30:33 , 35 ; || עקדים 30:35 ; || both, 30:39 (all J); of high places, variegated (gaily-coloured shrines) Ezek 16:16 . Pu`al Participle מְטֻלָּאוֺת patched , of sandals Josh 9:5 (JE).

occurrences.englishText: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
